v.q: Which diseases are associated with BRCA1?

v.meta: ? Answered13.0s · 13 tool calls · 21 sources cited from 3 layers

v.claimsStart:
BRCA1 is associated with familial cancer of breast, familial breast-ovarian cancer susceptibility 1, pancreatic cancer susceptibility 4, and Fanconi anemia complementation group S.⁠1–4 I found 4 conditions related to BRCA1.⁠1–4

The protein it produces joins with other tumor-suppressing and DNA-sensing proteins to form a large complex that watches for DNA damage.⁠23 It plays a role in repairing double-stranded breaks in DNA and in recombination.⁠23 Changes in this gene account for roughly 40% of inherited breast cancers and over 80% of inherited breast and ovarian cancers combined.⁠23

One is double-strand break repair via homologous recombination.⁠24 Another is DNA repair.⁠25 Another is regulation of DNA repair.⁠26 Another is DNA damage tolerance.⁠27

BRCA1, and its gene symbol is BRCA1.⁠8, 5
